item.name: Watch history contract, ownership and pagination

exec: const base = pm.variables.replaceIn('{{baseUrl}}'); const token = pm.collectionVariables.get('entitledAccessToken'); const other = pm.collectionVariables.get('unentitledAccessToken'); const uuids = JSON.parse(pm.environment.get('historyVideoUuids')); const hidden = JSON.parse(pm.environment.get('historyHiddenVideoUuids')); const send = (method, path, bearer, body) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => pm.sendRequest({ url: base + path, method, header: Object.assign({ 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, bearer ? { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + bearer } : {}), body: body === undefined ? undefined : { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify(body) } }, (error, response) => error ? reject(error) : resolve(response))); const assertError = (response, status, path) => { pm.expect(response.code).to.equal(status); const body = response.json(); pm.expect(Object.keys(body).sort()).to.eql(['errorCode','errorName','path','statusCode','timestamp'].sort()); pm.expect(body.statusCode).to.equal(status); pm.expect(body.path).to.equal(path); pm.expect(new Date(body.timestamp).toISOString()).to.equal(body.timestamp); }; const assertList = (response, items, page, hasNext) => { pm.expect(response.code).to.equal(200); const body = response.json(); pm.expect(Object.keys(body).sort()).to.eql(['hasNext','items','page'].sort()); pm.expect(body.page).to.equal(page); pm.expect(body.hasNext).to.equal(hasNext); pm.expect(body.items).to.have.length(items.length); pm.expect(body.items.map(item => item.videoUuid)).to.eql(items); for (const item of body.items) { pm.expect(Object.keys(item).sort()).to.eql(['videoUuid','contentType','lastPlayedAt','dramaUuid','dramaTitle','imageUrl','durationMs','episodeUuid','episodeNumber','episodeTitle'].sort()); pm.expect(item.lastPlayedAt).to.match(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T.*Z$/); pm.expect(item.durationMs).to.be.a('number').and.above(0); pm.expect(item).not.to.have.property('positionMs'); pm.expect(item).not.to.have.property('isCompleted'); if (item.contentType === 'PREVIEW') { pm.expect(item.episodeUuid).to.equal(null); pm.expect(item.episodeNumber).to.equal(null); pm.expect(item.episodeTitle).to.equal(null); } else { pm.expect(item.contentType).to.equal('EPISODE'); pm.expect(item.episodeUuid).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(item.episodeNumber).to.be.a('number'); } } return body; }; (async () => { const phase = pm.environment.get('historyPhase'); if (phase === 'seed') { const empty = await send('GET', '/me/watch-history', other); assertList(empty, [], 1, false); const outsiderWrite = await send('PUT', '/me/videos/' + uuids[0] + '/watch-progress', other, { event: 'STARTED', positionMs: 0 }); pm.expect(outsiderWrite.code).to.equal(204); assertList(await send('GET', '/me/watch-history', other), [uuids[0]], 1, false); for (const uuid of uuids.slice(0, 30)) { const write = await send('PUT', '/me/videos/' + uuid + '/watch-progress', token, { event: 'STARTED', positionMs: 0 }); pm.expect(write.code).to.equal(204); } const firstThirty = uuids.slice(0, 30).reverse(); assertList(await send('GET', '/me/watch-history?page=1', token), firstThirty, 1, false); const thirtyFirst = await send('PUT', '/me/videos/' + uuids[30] + '/watch-progress', token, { event: 'STARTED', positionMs: 0 }); pm.expect(thirtyFirst.code).to.equal(204); const thirtyOneOrder = [uuids[30], ...firstThirty.slice(0, 29)]; assertList(await send('GET', '/me/watch-history?page=1', token), thirtyOneOrder, 1, true); assertList(await send('GET', '/me/watch-history?page=2', token), [firstThirty[29]], 2, false); for (const uuid of uuids.slice(31)) { const write = await send('PUT', '/me/videos/' + uuid + '/watch-progress', token, { event: 'STARTED', positionMs: 0 }); pm.expect(write.code).to.equal(204); } const finalOrder = [...uuids.slice(31).reverse(), ...uuids.slice(0, 31).reverse()]; const list = await send('GET', '/me/watch-history?page=1&userUuid=' + pm.environment.get('unentitledUserUuid'), token); assertList(list, finalOrder.slice(0, 30), 1, true); const page2 = await send('GET', '/me/watch-history?page=2', token); assertList(page2, finalOrder.slice(30), 2, false); const completed = await send('PUT', '/me/videos/' + uuids[0] + '/watch-progress', token, { event: 'COMPLETED', positionMs: 41000 }); pm.expect(completed.code).to.equal(204); const restarted = await send('PUT', '/me/videos/' + uuids[0] + '/watch-progress', token, { event: 'STARTED', positionMs: 0 }); pm.expect(restarted.code).to.equal(204); const afterRestart = await send('GET', '/me/watch-history', token); pm.expect(afterRestart.code).to.equal(200); pm.expect(afterRestart.json().items.filter(item => item.videoUuid === uuids[0])).to.have.length(1); pm.environment.set('historyPhase', 'seeded'); } else { const ordered = JSON.parse(pm.environment.get('historyExpectedVideoUuids')); const recentUuid = pm.environment.get('historyRecentVideoUuid'); const restart = await send('PUT', '/me/videos/' + recentUuid + '/watch-progress', token, { event: 'STARTED', positionMs: 0 }); pm.expect(restart.code).to.equal(204); const expected = [recentUuid, ...ordered.filter(uuid => uuid !== recentUuid)]; const first = assertList(await send('GET', '/me/watch-history?page=1', token), expected.slice(0, 30), 1, expected.length > 30); assertList(await send('GET', '/me/watch-history?page=2', token), expected.slice(30), 2, false); pm.expect(first.items.find(item => item.videoUuid === recentUuid).lastPlayedAt).to.be.a('string'); const noAuth = await send('GET', '/me/watch-history', null); assertError(noAuth, 401, '/me/watch-history'); const invalid = await send('GET', '/me/watch-history?page=0', token); assertError(invalid, 400, '/me/watch-history?page=0'); const duplicate = await send('GET', '/me/watch-history?page=1&page=2', token); assertError(duplicate, 400, '/me/watch-history?page=1&page=2'); const badAuth = await send('GET', '/me/watch-history', 'invalid.access.token'); assertError(badAuth, 401, '/me/watch-history'); for (const uuid of hidden) { const response = await send('GET', '/me/watch-history?userUuid=' + pm.environment.get('unentitledUserUuid'), token); pm.expect(response.code).to.equal(200); pm.expect(response.json().items.map(item => item.videoUuid)).not.to.include(uuid); } const dramaUuid = pm.environment.get('historyDramaUuid'); const detail = await send('GET', '/dramas/' + dramaUuid, token); pm.expect(detail.code).to.equal(200); const imageUrls = detail.json().imageUrls; const previewItem = first.items.find(item => item.videoUuid === pm.environment.get('historyPreviewVideoUuid')); pm.expect(previewItem.dramaUuid).to.equal(dramaUuid); pm.expect(previewItem.imageUrl).to.equal(imageUrls.posterLandscape || imageUrls.poster); const noImage = first.items.find(item => item.videoUuid === pm.environment.get('historyNoImageVideoUuid')); pm.expect(noImage.imageUrl).to.equal(null); const posterOnlyUuid = pm.environment.get('historyPosterOnlyVideoUuid'); const posterOnlyItem = first.items.find(item => item.videoUuid === posterOnlyUuid); const posterOnlyDetail = await send('GET', '/dramas/' + posterOnlyItem.dramaUuid, token); pm.expect(posterOnlyDetail.code).to.equal(200); pm.expect(posterOnlyDetail.json().imageUrls.posterLandscape).to.equal(null); pm.expect(posterOnlyItem.imageUrl).to.equal(posterOnlyDetail.json().imageUrls.poster); pm.expect(first.items.some(item => item.videoUuid === pm.environment.get('historyPaidVideoUuid'))).to.equal(true); pm.expect(first.items.some(item => item.videoUuid === pm.environment.get('historyAlternateVideoUuid'))).to.equal(true); } })().catch(error => pm.test('watch-history HTTP scenarios complete', () => { throw error; }));

item.name: An empty page has no continuation

exec: pm.test('the empty following page has no continuation', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(Object.keys(body).sort()).to.eql(['hasNext','items','page'].sort()); pm.expect(body.page).to.equal(3); pm.expect(body.items).to.eql([]); pm.expect(body.hasNext).to.equal(false); });
